note: Java Arena's practice version of JavaFX, part 14: colors and their formulas, PNG images read from files/ (an RGBA one with transparent and half-transparent pixels, and a 4-bit palette one with a transparent color) and read pixel by pixel, five PNG files whose compressed pixels are broken (a bad zlib header, a bad block type, bad stored block lengths, data cut short, too little data: the browser engine's Inflater reports them differently from the JDK's, and the error images must be the same), addresses that name no file to read (an empty path, a folder, another computer, a path that can't be decoded: the browser engine's file: connection fails on these in its own way, and they must be the same error images), a WritableImage built pixel by pixel and copied, a canvas with every drawing call, mouse press, drag, release and click (with the events that can't happen), a slider that snaps to ticks and redraws a chart, line, bar and scatter charts with number and category axes, a series added twice, and the window JSON of all of them. The PNG files were made by our own code.
